purpose: Add another characteristic that strengthens the same evaluation.
keywords: Plain form + 上に; noun + の / な-adjective + な + 上に
This restaurant is inexpensive and serves delicious food.
It rained, and on top of that the wind grew strong.
She is kind, and her explanations are also easy to follow.
formation: Plain form + 上に; noun + の / な-adjective + な + 上に
restrictions: Usually combines positive with positive or negative with negative.
mistake: Use のに or が for a contrast rather than stacking opposing evaluations.
